## Steer queue fix

The drop came from the reconnect path: it cleared the **pending buffer** before the flush. See [the protocol notes](https://docs.example.com/steer) — a local link stays plain text, and the chart *queue depth chart* is not loaded.

With `n` steers queued, the flush costs $O(n)$ and the latency bound is

$$
T = \sum_{i=1}^{n} t_i
$$
The run costs $12 and $5 more on CI.
